data.title: Crypto ETFs in 2026: Bitcoin, Ethereum and the Altcoin Wave Explained
data.description: Just two years ago, owning cryptocurrency meant setting up a digital wallet, trusting an exchange, and safeguarding a private key. Today, you can own Bitcoin, Ethereum, and even Solana or XRP with a single click in your regular brokerage account through a crypto ETF. The category has exploded into hundreds of billions in assets, led by a single fund that has become one of the most successful ETF launches in history.
